div.head: Af 31
div.ab: XXV. Gif he sy XII hynde, ælc heora CXX scill', ond se slaga wer ond wite.
XXVI. Gif he sie twelfhynde, ælc hiora hundtwelftig scill., se slaga wer ⁊ wite.
Si twelfhind sit, quotquot interfuerint CXX sol. reddant, et occisor weram et witam.
{XXVI} Gif he sie twelfhynde, ælc hiora hundtwelftig scill, se slaga wer ⁊ wite.
If he should be [a] 1,200-[wergild man], each of [the members of the band] 120 shillings, the slayer wer and fine.
If the wergeld of the slain man is 1200 shillings, each of them [shall pay] 120 shillings; and the homicide [shall pay] the wergeld and the fine.
If he is a man of a twelve-hundred wergild, each of them [is to pay] 120 shillings, and the slayer the wergild and the fine.
Wenn der [Erschlagene] 1200 [Schilling werth] ist, [zahle] jeder von jenen [Begleitern] 120 Schilling, der Todtschläger [selbst] Wergeld und Strafgeld.
If the [slain man] is [worth] 1200 [shillings], [let] each of those [companions pay] 120 shillings, the slayer [himself] the wergeld and the fine.
div.note: Whitelock numbers this chapter 31 and gives Liebermann’s number, 31, in brackets.
